title: Latency vs accuracy bifurcation matrices for microbatching and prefix-caching rollouts
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Background: recent config rollouts that adjust microbatch sizing and prefix/KV cache TTLs have produced non-obvious tradeoffs: small improvements in token throughput occasionally correspond to subtle degradations in accuracy-sensitive slices. Goal: produce a set of reproducible, slice-aware "bifurcation matrices" that map representative workloads to operational knobs (microbatch_size, batch_window_ms, prefix_cache_ttl, prefix_cache_enabled). The matrices must expose regions where latency improvements bifurcate into measurable accuracy regressions so we can encode rollout/guardrail rules into Console and automated canaries. Scope: hosted API + Dedicated runtime on A100/RTX-capable nodes. Not in-scope: quantization profiles and model architecture changes (separate PR).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible experiment harness (notebooks + pipeline) that runs the full config grid and stores outputs to the eval datastore
Bifurcation matrices covering at least 4 representative slices (short prompts, long context, code completion, conversational grounding) with clear visual thresholds
A candidate canary policy describing safe step sizes for microbatch and prefix_cache_ttl changes derived from the matrix
Two runbooks: (1) how to rerun a failing rollout slice; (2) how to rollback config when accuracy delta > 2% on critical slices
Automated dashboard (per-model & per-route) that surfaces the primary tradeoff axes and highlights slice regressions > threshold
plan: Assemble 4 representative prompt slices and baseline metrics (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, token-cost, human/auto accuracy metrics)
Design factorial grid: microbatch_size = [1,2,4,8], batch_window_ms = [0,10,25], prefix_cache_ttl = [0s,10s,60s,300s], prefix_cache_enabled = [true,false]
Run distributed experiments (k = 3 seeds) across current stable model and the candidate model variant for A100 and RTX pools
Aggregate metrics and compute slice-wise bifurcation boundaries where latency reduction correlates with accuracy drop beyond noise floor
Draft canary rules and add to rollout playbook; implement dashboard widgets and alert rules for Console
Peer review: share results with PM/Design/Applied ML for signal validation and UI copy for Console
